defects: Suspected duplicate: service period 2026-02-15/2026-03-14 overlaps the prior PAID invoice HL-3301 (2026-02-01/2026-02-28) by 14 days, same vendor, same PO-4422, identical $4,300.00 gross, 19 days apart
rationale: Clause 8 criteria 1-4 are all met against paid invoice HL-3301 (same vendor after suffix normalisation, same PO-4422, gross equal, 19 days apart), but the service periods are neither identical nor non-overlapping — they overlap 15-28 Feb — so the clause 8.1 recurring-charge safe harbour does not clearly apply and a full DUPLICATE_REJECT is not supportable either. That is contradictory evidence under clause 11, so escalation is required. Two-way match only is correct for a SERVICES PO (clause 1); price matches PO exactly and tax of $300.00 equals 7.5% of $4,000.00 (clause 5), so the recommended payable is the full $4,300.00 if the buyer confirms the billing period has shifted rather than been double-billed. Net payable under $10,000.00 sets AP_CLERK authority (clause 10).
